verdict.rationale: Cake documents both migration paths. Spreadsheet cap tables can go through bulk upload tools in under two hours, and Carta and Pulley moves are a free managed migration within 48 hours. The help centre has export guides for each source platform, and a human reviews the matched data, which you can check before paying. Missing for 10: detail on self-serve import validation and error handling, explicit reconciliation against source legal documents (beyond attaching previously issued certificates), and independent or hands-on corroboration of migration accuracy.
